{"title": "ML Workshop - Guide", "type": "markdown", "aggs": [], "params": {"fontSize": 12, "openLinksInNewTab": false, "markdown": "## ML Workshop

Synthetic multi-tenant retail/ordering platform: 6 APM services, 5 app codes, 200 stores. Seeded anomalies A1-A7 sit in the last 10 days (see docs/anomalies.md). Use the global search box if a menu path differs in your project.

### Exercise 1 - Explore mlws-apm-multimetric
1. Open [Anomaly Detection Jobs](/app/ml/jobs) and find **mlws-apm-multimetric** (group mlws).
2. Click the job's **Anomaly Explorer** action. Set the time range to the last 14 days.
3. Find the swim lane hot spots: A1 cart-api (low throughput), A2 orders-api (latency), A4 payments-gateway (failures).
4. Open an anomaly, then **Single Metric Viewer** to see the model bounds; run a 3 day **forecast**.

### Exercise 2 - Build apm_tx_metrics from a recognized module
1. Jobs > **Create job** > data view **APM (workshop)** / index `metrics-apm.transaction.1m-mlws`.
2. Choose **Use preconfigured jobs** > **APM: Transaction data**.
3. Set **Job ID prefix** to `mlws-` and start in real time from before A1. Compare the result with Exercise 1.

### Exercise 3 - Level-filtered versus correct
1. Compare **mlws-logs-errors-correct** and **mlws-logs-errors-level-filtered** around A5 (ABC, 2 days ago, 16:00 UTC).
2. On each job open **Job management > Datafeed preview** and look at ABC documents. Use the catalog sync saved searches on this dashboard to see why the filtered job misses the INFO-level rejections.

### Exercise 4 - Alert rules after `inject cascade`
1. Run `python setup.py inject cascade` and wait about 20 minutes.
2. Compare rules **mlws-ml-native-record** and **mlws-ml-per-partition** in [Rules](/app/management/insightsAndAlerting/triggersActions/rules).
3. Check the **Alerts history** panel: one alert per job versus one per service.

### Links
- [Anomaly Explorer](/app/ml/explorer)
- [Single Metric Viewer](/app/ml/timeseriesexplorer)
- [Job management](/app/ml/jobs)
- [Notifications and job messages](/app/ml/notifications)
- [Rules](/app/management/insightsAndAlerting/triggersActions/rules)
- [Discover](/app/discover)
- [APM services](/app/apm/services)
"}}
